scripts.test: npm run test:public && npm run test:operations && npm run staff:test
scripts.ops:db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply focus-lab-operations-local --local --config operations/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ops:db:seed: wrangler d1 execute focus-lab-operations-local --local --config operations/wrangler.jsonc --file operations/seeds/development.sql
scripts.ops:db:reset: node operations/scripts/reset-local-db.mjs && npm run ops:db:migrate && npm run ops:db:seed
scripts.ops:db:inspect: wrangler d1 execute focus-lab-operations-local --local --config operations/wrangler.jsonc --command="SELECT id, workflow_state, created_at FROM inquiries ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.ops:staging:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply focuslab-crm-staging --remote --env staging --config operations/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ops:staging:seed: wrangler d1 execute focuslab-crm-staging --remote --env staging --config operations/wrangler.jsonc --file operations/seeds/development.sql
scripts.ops:staging:deploy: npm run staff:build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --config operations/wrangler.jsonc
